============================================================

                        CLEAN GLIDES
                LINUX INSTALLATION GUIDE

============================================================

1. INSTALLATION
------------------------------------------------------------

Format:        VST3
Architectures: @ARCHS@ (64-bit Linux)
               Your DAW automatically loads the matching build.
Requirements:  glibc 2.35 or newer (for example Ubuntu 22.04
               or newer, Debian 12 or newer) and the usual
               desktop libraries: ALSA, FreeType, Fontconfig
               and X11. They are normally already present on
               any system used for audio production.

OPTION A - INSTALL SCRIPT (RECOMMENDED)

  1. Close your DAW.
  2. Extract this ZIP archive.
  3. Open a terminal in the extracted folder and run:

       bash install.sh

     This installs the plugin for your user only, in
     ~/.vst3 (no administrator rights needed). The script
     detects your processor and installs only the build
     that matches it.

     To install for all users instead, run:

       bash install.sh --system

     This installs to /usr/local/lib/vst3 and asks for
     your password (sudo).

     To keep every build included in this archive, add:

       --all

      Options can be combined, for example:

       bash install.sh --system --all

  4. Restart your DAW and rescan your plugins if needed.

OPTION B - MANUAL INSTALLATION

  1. Close your DAW.
  2. Extract this ZIP archive.
  3. OPTIONAL - remove the build you do not need. Your DAW
     only uses the build matching your processor, so the
     other one just takes a little disk space. Check your
     processor in a terminal:

       uname -m

     x86_64   ->  delete the folder
                  "Clean Glides.vst3/Contents/aarch64-linux"
     aarch64  ->  delete the folder
                  "Clean Glides.vst3/Contents/x86_64-linux"

     If you are unsure, keep both: it works either way.
  4. Copy the entire "Clean Glides.vst3" folder to one of
     the standard VST3 locations, for example:

       mkdir -p ~/.vst3
       cp -R "Clean Glides.vst3" ~/.vst3/

     Other locations scanned by most DAWs:

       /usr/local/lib/vst3
       /usr/lib/vst3

  5. Restart your DAW and rescan your plugins if needed.

NOTES

  - Copy the whole folder, not only the file inside it.
  - An existing version is replaced.
  - If your DAW does not find the plugin, check that its
    VST3 search paths include the folder you installed to.
  - To uninstall, delete the folder:

       rm -rf ~/.vst3/"Clean Glides.vst3"
